title: Rolling Sniffer
description: This datapack provides functionality for controlling sniffers using the torchlight as a vehicle.
body:
# Sniffer is moving!
This datapack provides functionality for controlling **sniffers** using the torchlight as a vehicle. 

To activate the functionality, run the command: 

## /trigger SniffWeapon set 1

This command allows you to give the player a torchlight, which serves as a device for controlling the movements of the sniffer.

**Also feeding it torchlight seeds will speed it up**
